mapper.update: UPDATE run SET state = 'FAILED', error_code = 'MAX_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED', result_payload = jsonb_build_object('reason', '重试次数已达上限'), completed_at = now(), lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND state = 'RUNNING' AND attempt >= #{maxAttempts} AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at < now())

WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT run_id FROM run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND lease_owner IS DISTINCT FROM #{sseDirectLeaseOwner} AND (state = 'QUEUED' OR (state = 'RUNNING' AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at < now()))) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE run r SET state = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_expires_at = now() + (#{leaseSeconds} || ' seconds')::interval, fencing_token = r.fencing_token + 1, attempt = r.attempt + 1, updated_at = now() FROM candidates c WHERE r.run_id = c.run_id RETURNING r.run_id AS runId, r.fencing_token AS fencingToken, r.lease_expires_at AS leaseExpiresAt, r.attempt AS attempt, r.deadline_at AS deadlineAt

UPDATE run SET state = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_expires_at = now() + (#{leaseSeconds} || ' seconds')::interval, fencing_token = fencing_token + 1, attempt = attempt + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND run_id = #{runId}::uuid AND fencing_token = #{fencingToken} AND (state = 'QUEUED' OR (state = 'RUNNING' AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at < now()))) RETURNING run_id AS runId, fencing_token AS fencingToken, lease_expires_at AS leaseExpiresAt, attempt AS attempt, deadline_at AS deadlineAt

UPDATE run SET state = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_expires_at = now() + (#{leaseSeconds} || ' seconds')::interval, fencing_token = fencing_token + 1, attempt = attempt + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND run_id = #{runId}::uuid AND fencing_token = #{fencingToken} AND state = 'WAITING_APPROVAL' AND lease_owner IS NULL RETURNING run_id AS runId, fencing_token AS fencingToken, lease_expires_at AS leaseExpiresAt, attempt AS attempt, deadline_at AS deadlineAt

UPDATE run SET lease_expires_at = now() + (#{leaseSeconds} || ' seconds')::interval, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND run_id = #{runId}::uuid AND state = 'RUNNING' AND lease_owner = #{workerId} AND fencing_token = #{fencingToken}

UPDATE run SET state = #{newState}::run_state, result_payload = #{resultPayloadJson}::jsonb, error_code = #{errorCode}, completed_at = now(), lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND run_id = #{runId}::uuid AND state = 'RUNNING' AND fencing_token = #{fencingToken}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND run_id = #{runId}::uuid AND fencing_token = #{fencingToken}
SELECT fencing_token FROM run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND run_id = #{runId}::uuid
mapper.update: UPDATE run SET state = 'CANCELLED'::run_state, cancel_requested_at = now(), completed_at = now(), lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND run_id = #{runId}::uuid AND state IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM run WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND run_id = #{runId}::uuid AND (state = 'CANCELLED' OR cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE run SET state = 'FAILED'::run_state, error_code = 'APPROVAL_TIMEOUT', error_message = '等待人工审批超时，未执行', result_payload = '{"reason":"approval_timeout"}'::jsonb, completed_at = now(), updated_at = now(), lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND state = 'WAITING_APPROVAL' AND updated_at < now() - (#{maxWaitingSeconds} || ' seconds')::interval
